title: Add bundled video keyframe provider

context.summary: Add a real ffmpeg-based video keyframe provider profile.
context.background: Video processing must not depend only on embedded manifests or user-supplied custom commands.

in: Add bundled ffmpeg keyframe extraction provider configuration.
Validate ffmpeg availability in installer and runtime health checks.
Extract at most the configured keyframe count and store frame artifacts.
Run configured OCR/vision handlers on extracted frames.
Remove TASK-100-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Full video transcoding or streaming playback.

acceptance_criteria: A configured ffmpeg provider extracts real keyframes from a video fixture.
The max keyframe limit is enforced.
Frame artifacts include timestamps and source refs.
Extracted frames flow through enabled image OCR/vision handlers.

manual_checks: Confirm installer explains how to install ffmpeg if missing.

risks: ffmpeg availability differs by OS and container image.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
